seed_ledger.name: Aliquippa Data Center Campus power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: no source says how the plant gets gas. Cleanview lists a planned 496 MW site on 28 acres by Fezzik Energy and names no gas supplier or pipe. A tracker listing and the GOGPT entry add nothing on supply. A Public Utility Commission filing shows only an unrelated Peoples Natural Gas street main renewal in Aliquippa. The Pennsylvania air permit list for Beaver County has no entry for this project. No Federal Energy Regulatory Commission filing, EIA project row, county or city record, or trade press story was found. A web search for local news returned nothing. Nearest existing line is the National Fuel Gas Supply main line (P6878), 4 km away, not confirmed. Searches run: 9. Sources checked: Cleanview (planned, no gas info), tracker listings (proposed, no gas info), Peoples Gas PUC filing (unrelated), GASP Beaver County permit list (no entry), trade press and FERC queries (nothing).

evidence.note: planned 496 MW, Fezzik Energy, no gas supply named

seed_ledger.name: Bluegrass power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: the Ohio Power Siting Board approved the 800 MW behind-the-meter plant (case 25-227-EL-BGN) in Jefferson Township, Fayette County, next to the Midwest Mega Commerce Center. Coverage names no gas supplier or pipe. Amazon bought land nearby but no source ties it to this plant. Site profiles say Dominion Energy Transmission has a 26 inch gas line on the Mega Commerce site, which is a lead, not a confirmed supply. No Ohio EPA air permit, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission filing, EIA project row or trade press story naming the supply was found. The Hope Utilities line in the news is for a different data center. Nearby lines are Texas Gas Borealis (P7794) and Eastern Gas Transmission (P3220). Searches run: 8. Sources checked: Highland County Press OPSB story (no gas info), Dayton Daily News and Cleanview on Amazon (no gas plant), Mega Commerce site profile (on-site 26 inch line), Pipeline and Gas Journal (other project), air permit and FERC searches (nothing).

evidence.note: OPSB approval, behind the meter, no gas supply named

seed_ledger.name: Chesterfield Energy Reliability Center (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: Drop kept on a source. Dominion's project page says the plant needs no new pipelines or transmission outside Dominion-owned property, so there is no new pipe to add. It is a 944 MW utility peaker at the existing Chesterfield station, approved by the Virginia State Corporation Commission in November 2025. Data centers are named as demand context only, and the plant is not captive for one. Columbia Gas Transmission (P0169) runs 0.6 km away but no source names it as the supplier. Searches run: 7. Sources checked: Dominion project page (no new pipelines), Virginia Mercury on SCC approval (peaker, data center demand context), Data Center Dynamics (Dominion frames plant around data center growth), FERC and air permit queries (nothing on a lateral).

evidence.note: no new pipelines outside Dominion property
